title: BoJ Summary of Opinions — March 17-18, 2027 MPM
source: EST: boj.or.jp/en/mopo/mpmsche_minu/ ('Monetary Policy Meetings'), fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 41,959 bytes) and parsed row-by-row out of its two year tables by this session. Against the header 'Outlook Report (The Bank's View) | Summary of Opinions | MPM Minutes', the 2027 March row parses exactly as ['Mar. 17 (Wed.), 18 (Thurs.)', '-', 'Mar. 29 (Mon.)', 'May 7 (Fri.)'] — i.e. the Summary of Opinions for the March 2027 MPM publishes 2027-03-29, with no Outlook Report attached to that meeting and the full Minutes following 2027-05-07. Filed estimate on two counts, identical to the five BoJ decision entries already on this calendar: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts (IR:/CAL:/BLS:/FED:/PJM:/SEC:/TSY:/OCC:/BEA:/CENSUS:/ISM:/CB:/UMICH:) has FED: for the Federal Reserve and no slot for the Bank of Japan, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Release time is not read off this page and is not asserted here
notes: DISCOVERED during the japan-cpi-tokyo-flash-2027-03-26 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05). It is the first BoJ text of any kind to publish after the two March 2027 Japanese CPI releases, and the ONE TRAP IT CARRIES is that this makes it look like a BoJ reading of them, which it is not: a Summary of Opinions summarises views expressed AT the meeting it names, so this document is written on 2027-03-17/18 and contains no reaction to the national February print (japan-cpi-2027-03-19, estimate) or to the Tokyo March flash and FY2026 Tokyo fiscal average (japan-cpi-tokyo-flash-2027-03-26, estimate). The first BoJ venue that actually holds both is the 2027-04-27/28 MPM (boj-decision-2027-04-28, estimate), which is also the first post-food-tax-cut Outlook Report. Why it earns a row anyway: 2027-03-29 is the FIRST US SESSION after a four-day gap — the NYSE is shut Good Friday 2027-03-26 (good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26) and the Tokyo flash lands 19:30 EDT on Thursday 2027-03-25, so nothing US-traded can respond to either Japanese release until this Monday, which then carries three stories at once (this release, the FTC v. Amazon trial opening in ftc-v-amazon-antitrust-trial-2027-03-29, and a three-session quarter-end stub week). That is an attribution hazard worth having named on the calendar rather than rediscovered. Impact is LOW: symbols is empty, no house playbook is rates- or FX-keyed, and the BoJ channel to this calendar's AI names runs through yen funding and global term premium, both second-order for a US equity book and both already owned by the FOMC ledgers. Precedent for filing a central-bank meeting-account release as its own entry: fomc-minutes-2026-12-30 and ecb-account-2026-10-08, both kind 'macro-print'.
